martyrdom: Traditionally speared to death near modern Chennai, India

en.name: Thomas
en.summary: Remembered for doubting the Resurrection until he could see and touch Jesus's wounds.
en.body: Thomas, called Didymus ("the Twin"), is best known for the episode that gave rise to the phrase "doubting Thomas": absent when the risen Jesus first appeared to the other apostles, he refused to believe until he could see and touch the wounds himself — and did so eight days later. Tradition credits him with carrying the Gospel to Persia and India, where the Saint Thomas Christians of Kerala trace their founding to his mission. He is said to have been martyred near modern Chennai.
